title: Dietitian assessment and protein-energy delivery in critically ill patients with kidney disease: MIMIC-III analysis code
description: Python code and reference tables that reproduce the analyses of the manuscript 'Dietitian assessment, timing of enteral nutrition and protein-energy delivery in critically ill patients with kidney disease: a retrospective cohort study' (MIMIC-III v1.4). No patient data are included; MIMIC-III must be obtained from PhysioNet under its data use agreement.
